name: State Judiciary Mains Mock Law Paper - Chapter Test
courseName: State Judiciary Mains Mock Law Paper

questions.question: Under which article of the Indian Constitution is the Supreme Court established?
questions.hint: Article 124 establishes the Supreme Court of India.

questions.question: Which section of the Indian Penal Code defines "Murder"?
questions.hint: Section 300 defines Murder, while Section 302 provides the punishment.

questions.question: The Indian Contract Act was enacted in the year:
questions.hint: The Indian Contract Act was enacted in 1872.

questions.question: Who administers the oath to the President of India?
questions.hint: The Chief Justice of India administers the oath of office to the President.

questions.question: What is the maximum number of members in the Lok Sabha?
questions.hint: The maximum strength of the Lok Sabha is 552.

questions.question: The concept of the "Preamble" in the Indian Constitution was amended by which act?
questions.hint: The 42nd Amendment of 1976 added the terms Socialist, Secular, and Integrity to the Preamble.

questions.question: Which section of the Code of Civil Procedure (CPC) deals with "Res Judicata"?
questions.hint: Section 11 of the CPC defines the rule of Res Judicata.

questions.question: Which section of the Indian Penal Code (IPC) defines the offence of "Theft"?
questions.hint: Section 378 defines theft, and Section 379 provides the punishment.

questions.question: Under which article of the Constitution of India can a citizen move the Supreme Court directly for enforcement of Fundamental Rights?
questions.hint: Article 32 provides the Right to Constitutional Remedies to approach the SC.

questions.question: Which section of the Indian Evidence Act defines "Primary Evidence"?
questions.hint: Section 62 defines primary evidence as the document itself produced for inspection.

questions.question: What is the limitation period for filing a suit for possession of immovable property based on title?
questions.hint: Under the Limitation Act, the period is 12 years.

questions.question: In which year was the Transfer of Property Act enacted in India?
questions.hint: The Transfer of Property Act was enacted in 1882.

questions.question: Which section of the Indian Contract Act defines a "Void Agreement"?
questions.hint: Section 2(g) defines an agreement not enforceable by law as void.

questions.question: The Constitution of India was formally adopted on which date?
questions.hint: It was adopted on November 26, 1949 and came into effect on January 26, 1950.

questions.question: What is the minimum age required to be appointed as the Governor of an Indian State?
questions.hint: Article 157 prescribes 35 years as the minimum age for state governors.
